# PRINTFY 3D

> PRINTFY 3D is a 3D printing business based in Cairo, Egypt. It sells ready-made gifts, décor, incense holders, figurines, wall art and keychains, plus custom prints from an idea, photo, sketch or STL file. Prices are in EGP; delivery is available across Egypt.
